title: Identity derived transport for section-normalized relabelling
statement: For a section-normalized identity relabelling A and an ambient identity comparison c, the induced derived identity transport equals the canonical transport of the ordinary identity coherence k, and the corresponding transported Hom equation holds componentwise.

source.place: Step 6 identity specialization; transport of the canonical identity Hom square through the section-normalized relabelling.

proof.text: Compare the raw section maps of A.identity with the canonical site identity using Relabelling. Apply localization to obtain equality of the derived identity isomorphisms, then expand homComparison and use functoriality and the product identity to obtain the transported Hom equation.

theorem identity_transport_data (A : PodReindexFamily l E) (hA : A.Relabelling l E)
    (W : Scheme.{u}) [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
    (c : Comparison l E (𝟙 W))
    (k : PodReindexingCoherence.Identity l E W none)
    (M N : D l E W) :
    A.identityDerived l E W = (reindexIso l E (𝟙 W)).symm ≪≫ k.derived ∧
    (homComparison l E (𝟙 W) c M N).hom ≫
        (podReindexingDerivedHom l E W none).map
          (Prod.mkHom ((A.identityDerived l E W).inv.app M).op
            ((A.identityDerived l E W).hom.app N)) =
      (reindexIso l E (𝟙 W)).symm.hom.app (hom l E W M N) ≫
        c.derived.hom.app (op M, N) ≫
        (podReindexingDerivedHom l E W none).map
          (Prod.mkHom (k.derived.inv.app M).op (k.derived.hom.app N))
